title: Garmin Connect
summary: Optional direct sync for what Health Connect doesn't carry.
description: Garmin Connect has Training Effect, training load, heart-rate zones, power and laps per activity, and Body Battery, stress, sleep score and HRV status per day. Tally reads them through Garmin's official Personal API.

requirements.text: Garmin Connect is reached with a Personal API key the user pastes in Settings, kept in the app's data folder and traded for short-lived tokens.
An optional unofficial sign-in adds training readiness and training status for recent days.
An automatic Garmin sync runs at most every `garmin.auto-sync-interval`; a sync started from Settings ignores that limit.
Requests to Garmin are spaced at least `garmin.request-gap` apart.
When Garmin rate-limits, syncing stops for `garmin.rate-limit-pause`.
History is backfilled in chunks, one per sync, up to `garmin.backfill-max` back.
A Garmin activity attaches to the workout Health Connect already synced for it; an activity Health Connect doesn't have gets a workout of its own.
